votes.motion: A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Marci Houseman, to approve Ordinance 22-15, an ordinance annexing territory located at approximately9575 South, 3100 East, 9673 South, 3100 East, 3170 East Little Cottonwood Road, and 3220 East Little Cottonwood Road in Salt Lake Councty comprising approximately 11.56 Acres into the municipality of Sandy City; establishing zoning for the annexed property; also providing a severance and effective date for the annexation

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve Resolution 22-51C, a resolution increasing total appropriations within the general fund for the fiscal year commencing July 1, 2022 and ending June 30, 2023

A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Ryan Mecham to approve Resolution 22-49C, a resolution increasing total appropriations and reappropriating unexpended funds within the capital projects funds

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve Resolution 22-50C, a resolution increasing total appropriations and reappropriating unexpended funds within the special revenue funds

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Marci Houseman to approve the Alternative to Resolution 22-48C, a resolution increasing total apropriations and reappropriating unexpended funds within the proprietary funds with the amendment detailed in Exhibit H
A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Alison Stroud to convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Agency Board

A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to adopt Ordinance 22-09 an ordinance amending the Sandy City Municipal Code Title 14, "Traffic Code" Chapter 14-8, "Qualification of Vehicles, Registration, Equipment Restrictions", Section 14-8-1, "Commercial Vehicle in a Restricted Zone," also providing a saving clause and effective date for the ordinance
